title: NF Research Tools - Genetic Reagent
description: Genetic reagents including plasmids, viral vectors, CRISPR constructs, and other molecular biology tools.

3primeCloningSite.description: If Restriction Enzyme was selected as the cloning method, the enzyme used on the 3' (C-terminal) end.

3primeSiteDestroyed.description: Whether 3' site was destroyed during cloning.

3primer.description: Primer to sequence the 3' end (C-terminal) of the insert.

5primeCloningSite.description: If Restriction Enzyme was selected as the cloning method, the enzyme used on the 5' (N-terminal) end.

5primeSiteDestroyed.description: Whether 5' site was destroyed during cloning.

5primer.description: Primer to sequence the 5' end (N-terminal) of the insert.

aiSummary.description: A large language model-generated summary of the resource.

availability.description: How this resource can be obtained.

backboneSize.description: Size in bp of the backbone without the insert.

cTerminalTag.description: Tags on the C terminal 3' end of the gene insert. Only tags that are in frame.

copyNumber.description: Whether the plasmid produces sufficient DNA from a normal miniprep or requires special conditions.

dateAdded.description: The date that the resource was originally added.

dateModified.description: The last update of the resource metadata.

description.description: Free text description, summary, or purpose of the resource.

gRNAshRNASequence.description: The sequence of the gRNA or shRNA for the gene insert, if present.

growthStrain.description: The E. coli strain for distributing the plasmid.

growthTemp.description: Temperature for growing the bacteria hosting the plasmid.

hazardous.description: Whether the unmodified plasmid DNA requires handling at Biosafety Level 2 or higher.

howToAcquire.description: How to acquire a particular resource.

insertEntrezId.description: The Entrez Gene ID for the gene insert.

insertName.description: Name of the main gene insert in the plasmid.

insertSize.description: Size, in bp, of the gene insert as it is in the plasmid.

nTerminalTag.description: Tags on the N terminal 5' end of the gene insert. Only tags that are in frame.

promoter.description: Promoter driving the expression of the insert in the plasmid.

resourceId.description: A unique identifier for the resource.

resourceName.description: The canonical name of the resource.

rrid.description: The RRID, a standard resource identifier for interoperability with other databases. Must include the lowercase 'rrid:' prefix.

selectableMarker.description: Additional selection markers, such as mammalian selection markers or fluorescent proteins.

totalSize.description: Size of vector with insert. Derived from insertSize and backboneSize.

usageRequirements.description: Any known restrictions on use of the resource.

enum: generation of germ line transmitting chimeras not permitted
creation of functional gametes not permitted
generation of interspecies chimeras not permitted
cannot be used for treatment purposes
special licencing restrictions (see vendor for more information)

vectorBackbone.description: Name of the backbone the plasmid is built on (e.g. pGBT9).
